test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A person loses 12% by selling an item for ₹ 330. If he sells it for ₹ 367.50, find his percentage profit/loss.
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of the item = ₹ 330

Loss percentage = 12%

New selling price of the item = ₹ 367.50

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (C.P) = (Selling Price (S.P) × 100) / (100 - Loss%)

Profit/Loss Percentage = [(New S.P - C.P) / C.P] × 100
